u0: No boil needs attention: the pot is not boiling over, or the last boil has already been turned down. This is the normal resting and accepting state; continue other shop work while staying ready to react as soon as the pot starts boiling.
u1: The pot is boiling over and has not yet been turned down. Go to the stove promptly, ensuring the hands are empty—drop any carried food on an empty adjacent cell first if necessary—then face the stove and toggle it to stop the boil. Delay keeps incurring penalties; once fixed, return to the normal monitoring state.
